CLAUDE.md

Source: CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Shared conventions

The portfolio’s shared rules are synced into .claude/shared/ from pedrobtz/packages:claude/shared/. Never edit them here. Where this file and a shared file disagree, this file wins for this package.

@.claude/shared/workflow.md @.claude/shared/r-package.md @.claude/shared/ci.md @.claude/shared/native-code.md @.claude/shared/correctness.md @.claude/shared/assurance.md

This package predates those files and departs from them in a few places. Each departure is stated as one below, in the section it belongs to.

What this is

An R interface to the Apache DataSketches C++ library: KLL, REQ, t-Digest, HLL, CPC, Theta, Frequent Items, Count-Min, Array of Doubles (tuple), VarOpt, EBPPS and Bloom filter sketches. Each sketch is an R6 object wrapping a native sketch held in an external pointer. The package is a thin, validated binding. It does not reimplement algorithms, and it does not add sketch types that upstream lacks.

Deviation from the zero-dependency rule: runtime dependencies are R6 and rlang. The C++ side links cpp11 and the vendored headers, nothing else.

There is no design or roadmap document in this repository, and no .agents/ directory. Source comments refer to _dev/WORKING-ON.md, but that directory is build-ignored and not tracked, so it is not available. Treat the exported docs and the tests as the contract.

Current state

On CRAN as 0.1.1 (published 2026-09-23), clean on every CRAN check flavor (verified 2026-09-30). main is the development version, 0.1.1.9000. Every sketch listed in DESCRIPTION is implemented. Not implemented: typed file persistence (write_sketch()). Code comments still say it was deferred to 0.1.1; it was not built.

Gaps from the shared rules, as of 2026-11-11:

  • No .agents/assurance.md yet, which assurance.md expects of every package.
  • No cran-release.yaml, so the tag, the GitHub release and the .9000 bump are not automated (see Releasing below).
  • The R-CMD-check.yaml caller passes no profile: and has no workflow_dispatch: or weekly schedule:, unlike r-actions’ examples/.
  • The vendored tree is not under src/vendor/, and there is no PROVENANCE file, checksum record, tools/patches/ or own nm -u guard (see Vendored native code).

Versions and dependents

The current version’s parent issue is #17, v0.1.2. The cran-release reminder for it is #15: the earliest date CRAN’s cadence allows the next submission, the last Date/Publication plus six weeks. Sibling packages that depend on this one: none.

Releasing

Deviation, until a cran-release.yaml exists: releases go through a release/<version> branch that sets the version, NEWS.md and cran-comments.md. After CRAN accepts a release, bump to <version>.9000 by hand.

Commands

The shared commands apply. Specific to this package:

Rscript -e 'devtools::document()'                # also regenerates cpp11 registration
Rscript -e 'devtools::test(filter = "theta")'    # one sketch's test file
Rscript tools/update-datasketches-cpp.R          # refresh vendored headers

The first compile of src/ takes a minute or two because every bridge file instantiates large header-only templates.

Architecture

Each sketch family is one R file and one C++ file, paired by name, for example R/quantiles-kll-doubles.R and src/kll_doubles.cpp. The pattern is the same in every pair, so read one pair before touching another.

  • C++ bridge (src/<sketch>.cpp). Owns the native object in a cpp11::external_pointer tagged with a symbol such as data.sketches::kll_doubles_sketch. A *_from_xptr() helper checks the type and tag and that the pointer is non-null before any use. Functions exported to R are marked [[cpp11::register]] and end in _cpp; that suffix, not a prefix, marks the native symbols here. src/cpp11.cpp and R/cpp11.R are generated by devtools::document(); never edit them.
  • R6 generator (R/<family>-<sketch>.R). An internal R6Class with cloneable = FALSE holds the pointer in private$ptr. The exported constructor, such as kll_doubles(x, k, bytes), calls $new(). Two-sketch operations reach the other instance’s pointer through a <sketch>_ptr() helper that reads .__enclos_env__$private.
  • Validation (R/checks.R). All argument checks happen in R before the bridge is called. They raise classed rlang conditions through abort_invalid(). Native failures are rethrown onto the same hierarchy by abort_native(), deserialize_native() (bad bytes =) and check_not_empty(). check_alive() and the .datasketches_alive registry catch a sketch whose pointer died in saveRDS()/readRDS().
  • S3 methods (R/print.R). format, print, as.character and summary delegate to the R6 methods after check_alive().

Adding a sketch type touches all of these: the bridge, the R file, a validator and .datasketches_alive entry in R/checks.R, the S3 delegators in R/print.R, the sketch_builders list in tests/testthat/test-conditions.R, and the reference index in _pkgdown.yml.

Generated files beyond roxygen’s: R/cpp11.R and src/cpp11.cpp (by devtools::document()) and R/datasketches-version.R (by the updater script). Never edit them by hand. Deviation: README.md is the source; there is no README.Rmd.

Invariants that are easy to break

  • Interrupts must go through cpp11::check_user_interrupt(), never R_CheckUserInterrupt(). The latter longjmps past C++ destructors and leaks the input vector for the rest of the session. This shipped once and was fixed in 0.1.1. Probe on a 64k boundary (i > 0 && (i & 0xFFFF) == 0), not on every element and not on element 0.
  • Reject self-merge in R. Upstream merge() has no aliasing guard, so a$merge(a) is undefined behaviour. Every $merge() compares pointers with identical() first and raises datasketches_self_merge.
  • Every error is a datasketches_error. New checks use abort_invalid() with a datasketches_<kind> class. Deviation: the prefix is datasketches_, not the package name, and classes carry no _error suffix. New native paths that can throw on user input must be wrapped so the upstream std::exception never reaches the user as a bare simpleError.
  • Keep R and C++ bounds in sync. R validators mirror the C++ checks, for example check_k() and checked_k(). Integer-valued doubles that cross to uint64_t must stay within 2^53 (checked_uint64_from_double() in src/native_utils.h and check_uint64ish() in R).
  • Compact Theta and tuple payloads do not carry lg_k. A sketch restored from bytes = recovers a width hint from its retained count (lg_k_hint_from_retained()). Dropping that hint silently makes later merges and unions roughly ten times less accurate. This shipped once and was fixed in 0.1.1.
  • Theta $merge() freezes the receiver into compact form. It is rebuilt from a union result and can no longer be updated.
  • cdf() and pmf() return n + 1 values for n split points. rank() is length-preserving and maps NA input to NA_real_.
  • Hot loops read the raw buffer (REAL(values.data())), not cpp11’s per-element accessor, which dominates the cost on large vectors.

Testing

  • One test file per sketch, plus test-conditions.R (classed errors across every constructor) and test-interrupt-safety.R.
  • Assert with expect_error(..., class = "datasketches_...").
  • test-interrupt-safety.R uses setTimeLimit() to trigger the interrupt probes without a signal. It is skip_on_cran() because it allocates 2e7-element vectors.
  • There are no helper-*.R files and no external conformance corpus. The cross-implementation guarantee is that $serialize() bytes round-trip.
  • CRAN check time is under a minute on Linux; keep it there.

Continuous integration

Workflows come from pedrobtz/r-actions:

  • R-CMD-check.yaml calls r-cmd-check.yml@v1. It runs the GitHub runners and the CRAN-like r-devel containers (clang and GCC), which matter because the vendored headers are compiled with CRAN’s newest compilers. Its runners input restores the ubuntu-latest (devel) row that the r-actions default drops.
  • coverage.yaml calls coverage.yml pinned to a commit, because it runs with a write token. It commits the badge to gh-pages, not main.
  • pkgdown.yaml is the r-lib template. It builds the CRAN release at the site root and main into /dev/. It deploys with clean: false and force: false so it does not overwrite the coverage badge.

Required status checks are named R-CMD-check / <leg>.

Vendored native code

src/datasketches/ is Apache DataSketches C++ 5.2.0 (Apache-2.0), header-only, with upstream LICENSE and NOTICE alongside. It has no local patches. Deviation: the tree lives in src/datasketches/, not src/vendor/<lib>/. tools/update-datasketches-cpp.R pins the version in DATASKETCHES_VERSION, downloads that upstream tag’s tarball and replaces the tree. It also rewrites R/datasketches-version.R. After a bump, update inst/COPYRIGHTS, the include list in both src/Makevars and src/Makevars.win if components changed, and NEWS.md.
